scope.summary: Implement the native action/macro system: an operator records a live sequence of Studio commands into a named, reorderable StudioMacro (capture of the emitted command stream, not a separate scripting translation), plays it back over the current document, and re-records/edits steps. A recorded macro is a persisted StudioCommandBatch and replays under the transactional/undo semantics of MT-482.
acceptance_criteria: record/playback macro as StudioCommandBatch; reorderable; operator panel with author_ids
proof_targets: Argus record+playback of a macro; batch persistence
expected_tests: live: record a command sequence -> named macro; playback reproduces edits as one batch
argus: macro panel record/stop/play reachable by author_id

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Recording and playing macros

risk_if_missed: No macro system; operators must hand-script; recording forks a translation layer.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
